added: Staging and production are checked before a build - check-targets says what either lacks and -Fix fills in what the deploy config and the server tell it; build-release offers that fix and -FixTarget applies it first
other: Release builds carry their version, as the estimator's do: dist/ikaika-portal-backend-<version>[-debug].zip with its .sha256.

build-release tags and uploads when asked, as the estimator's does - -Tag, -Deploy, -DryRun - and -Clean, the Build release form's clean, removes the server's older backups and a failed deploy's leftovers.
build-release -Gui opens the project estimator's Build release dialog.
